newsitem.title: UK: B.A.T shares gain after U.S. strength.
newsitem.headline: B.A.T shares gain after U.S. strength.

text.p: Shares in B.A.T Industries Plc firmed on Tuesday after strong demand for shares in the tobacco-to-insurance conglomerate in the U.S. on Monday, dealers said.
"There was good demand in the U.S. last night," said one market-maker. B.A.T shares were up 7p at 524 by 0956 GMT in volume of 1.6 million shares.

B.A.T shares have been buoyed in recent months by speculation that the company will demerge its two arms, possibly as part of a move by U.S. tobacco companies to reach a general settlement in smoking-related lawsuits.

B.A.T last month dismissed a newspaper report that it had approached other cigarette makers to set up an industry-wide fighting fund, though chief executive Martin Broughton said previously it was time to consider settling the claims.

Jury selection got underway on Monday in the latest trial of a lawsuit against the tobacco industry. A jury being picked in Jacksonville, Florida will hear the trial of a lawsuit against RJR Reynolds, a unit of RJR Nabisco Holdings Corp.
